finding: Native client metric cards omit the arrow artwork shown by the Web component. The Web icon has inline display:inline-block, which overrides the responsive stylesheet's ordinary display:none. The explicit native icon binding omitted that inline default.
correction: Match the Web icon's inline display, vertical alignment, aspect ratio and stroke style defaults. An explicit style display:none and an important CSS display:none still hide the artwork.

checks.browser: Both actual Web and native client list previews must show four 16px metric arrows at each existing normal viewport.
